name: Infrastructure — Unsecured Reverse Proxy
description:
📖 Scenario

During your investigation, you discover that the web application is not directly exposed to the backend services.

A reverse proxy is positioned between the public network and an internal service. However, its security configuration may not have been properly hardened.

🎯 Mission

Investigate the infrastructure behind:

Flag.cgcybercom.online

Determine how the reverse proxy communicates with the backend service.

Submit only the required answer using the flag format: pcgCTF{answer}

hints.content: Look beyond the public-facing web application.
Network architecture can sometimes reveal services that aren't directly advertised.
Examine the reverse proxy and determine whether its administrative access has been properly secured.
